statement: xpadneo's source documentation distinguishes the 283-byte Series BLE example from Xbox One S Linux-mode 306-byte truncated and 334-byte complete descriptors, and from a 464-byte Elite Series 2 BLE 5.23 descriptor. Those are different model/firmware comparators and do not prove a 1914 Series descriptor transition between specific firmware builds.

applicability.revision: standard Xbox Series controller, model 1914, with explicitly labelled older/Elite comparators
applicability.scope: Cross-model scope: xpadneo xbxs.md:3-6; xb1s_linux.md:28-43; xbe2_ble.md:3-12; README.md:88-97.
